description: A clump-forming evergreen with glossy, dark green strap-shaped leaves that arch gracefully. Short cream flower spikes open low among the foliage in late spring, and the bright red berries that follow ripen in autumn and hold through winter. Grows well in shade and tolerates dry conditions once established.
